description: Pilot: import already-parsed axe JSON or Playwright JSON from an authenticated owner/editor/developer. Use dryRun=true to preview normalization and exact deduplication identities without writing. Repeated imports update one project + canonical page + device + rule + target record and preserve provenance. Failed observations may create or update open agent pins; passed, skipped, and inconclusive observations never resolve pins, change pin statuses, or qualify as trusted verification. The importer never reads files, fetches URLs, calls a provider, or uploads repository contents.

commitSha.description: Optional exact commit SHA associated with the run; metadata only, not deployment proof.

device.description: Viewport/device class. phone and handset normalize to mobile; pc and laptop normalize to desktop.

dryRun.description: Preview only. No cloud request, pins, statuses, or verification records are changed.

environment.description: Optional environment metadata such as staging or production.

formatVersion.description: Exact producer/result format version. Required when it cannot be inferred from the result payload.

pageUrl.description: Canonical page under the registered project URL. Query variants remain distinct; credentials and fragments are rejected/removed.

projectId.description: Exact Pincushion project ID. The server re-checks immutable owner/editor/developer access.

results.description: Already-parsed axe or Playwright JSON. No file path, URL fetch, or provider reference is accepted.

runId.description: Stable producer run identifier for safe replay and provenance.

source.description: Bounded source label such as github-actions or playwright-ci.

name: import_qa_results
title: Import QA Results
